# Official template provenance

The fixed `vite-ts` revision and original archive SHA256 are in `lock.json`.
The complete unmodified archive is retained as `upstream.tar.gz`. It was first
downloaded and hashed in session tools, then re-downloaded into this directory
after the authorized minimal peer correction. Both SHA256 values matched.

The template's package/entry/config patterns are adapted into this isolated
project; TypeScript/test dependencies are changed only as explicitly approved.
Only the authored login and onboarding pages are registered. Template example
UI/assets and unsupported product targets are not registered as product pages.
The fixed archive has **no LICENSE file**; the GitHub license endpoint at that
revision returned 404 on 2026-11-03. No new independent project license is claimed.
The repository's root AGPL-3.0 obligations are not removed by this directory.
